title: Preflight strictness: finite block-age tolerance, future blocks, checker bytecode, one ENABLED_CHAINS parse

options.name: Keep current preflight rules
options.risk: Infinity tolerance or a wrong clock passes the staleness check; any contract at the checker address passes (AUD-DB-017).

options.name: Require finite bounded tolerances, fail a block more than a small skew in the future, compare the checker code hash, parse ENABLED_CHAINS once
options.behavior_impact: Preflight refuses a few more misconfigurations at boot.
options.risk: A clock skew on the operator machine can now refuse boot; the checker hash must be updated with every redeploy.

default: Keep current behaviour until the owning phase decides (milestone contract); S3.
behavior_impact: Decides which misconfigurations stop the bot at boot.
